admission.justification: Realized in paseo_seat_policy.py, which resolves the roster, and in paseo_launch.py, which passes the role; tests compare the grant with the advertised allowlist per role and pin it on the launch path.

applicability: Fresh ordinary Paseo role launches and bound explainer seats that attach agents-remember-task.
conditions: The provider ID is exactly codex or claude.
The grant is built at creation, not replayed from a saved launch call.
exclusions: Saved launch calls and resumed seats, which keep the grant recorded at their start.
Other provider IDs, which receive no preapproval.
statement: A fresh ordinary Codex role launch grants and records exactly that role's ordered allowlist, while a roleless explainer grant keeps the full public roster and Claude keeps server_info.
